name: Memes 2 - We All Cry: Electric Boogaloo
source:
The long-awaited sequel of Memes - We All Cry! This time, we tied all the nonsense of the first game into a story- hopefully this doesn't deter your experience with Memes - We All Cry!

[From [url=https://the-riley-fanfiction-club.itch.io/memes-2]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
万众期待的《Memes - We All Cry》续作！这一次，我们把初代里所有的无厘头胡闹串联成了一个完整的故事——希望这不会影响你体验《Memes - We All Cry》的乐趣！

[引自[url=https://the-riley-fanfiction-club.itch.io/memes-2]Itch.io[/url]]
